name: Practice: Ch6 Inference for Categorical Data (Final-Exam Review)

source.purpose: Final Semester 2 review for Ch6 (Weeks 4-6 of S2). Existing Ch6 Practice Test (aid 22170278, avg 95.3%) and Ch6 IND Test (aid 22195968, avg 90.9%) ran in late Feb 2026. IND auto-graded items are solid (95%+) — the only real misses are the two FRQs at 58-59%, which were interpretation/conclusion-writing items. This practice drills FRQ-style interpretation in auto-graded form plus reuses the well-vetted FRQ files for the 3 essay slots.

hw_scrape_findings: HW 6.3 + 6.4 carry 20-27% incomplete rates on chi-square items — pattern matches Ch4-5 incomplete-rate findings: scores among finishers are 91-97% but engagement drops on multi-step chi-square tables. Practice drills slots 8-14 reuse short clean computational items.

Mixed Review (22110497) q18/q19 at 79-82% are the lowest student-completed items in Ch6 — abstract two-proportion HT with no context. Slot 6 (draft CI for diff of props) and slot 7 (draft when-to-use-which) target this conceptual weakness.
Ch6 IND auto-graded items all ≥90%. The two FRQs (q9 59%, q10 58%) are the entire delta between IND avg (90.9%) and a hypothetical 95%+ — interpretation is the bottleneck.

Ch6 Group Test q15 (Statistical Significance Interpretation, 46%) is the single lowest item in the entire Ch6 dataset. Slot 15 draft converts the FRQ prompt to multiple-choice form for auto-graded drill.
